meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Python SDK 或 REST API 操作你的 Benchling 账户，例如新建或更新 DNA、RNA、蛋白等实体，管理库存样本、电子实验记录与工作流，还能查询数据仓库数据。
howto.when: 当你要求用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API 自动化实验室数据，或提到管理生物序列、库存、实验记录等工作时触发。

say.text: 用SDK在Benchling里新建一个DNA序列，名字叫pGFP，碱基ATCG。
say.note: 会调用SDK创建实体并返回ID。

say.text: 查询Benchling库存中所有样本容器，列出前10个。
say.note: 会调用库存列表接口并展示结果。

say.text: 创建一个电子实验记录条目，并链接到指定DNA序列。
say.note: 会创建entry并建立实体链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Python SDK or REST API to operate your Benchling account: create/update entities such as DNA, RNA, proteins, manage inventory samples, ELN entries, workflows, and query the Data Warehouse.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate lab data with benchling-sdk or v2 API, or mention managing biological sequences, inventory, ELN entries, etc.

say_en.text: Create a new DNA sequence named pGFP with bases ATCG in Benchling via SDK.
say_en.note: Calls the SDK to create the entity and returns its ID.

say_en.text: List the first 10 sample containers in Benchling inventory.
say_en.note: Queries the inventory list endpoint and shows results.

say_en.text: Create an ELN entry and link it to a specific DNA sequence.
say_en.note: Creates the entry and establishes the entity link.
